Nottinghamshire | 21 Hours Per Week | c.£30,000 FTE (Pro Rata)
A great opportunity to join a friendly, established and growing accountancy practice!
Are you an organised and personable Finance or Accounts Administrator looking for a part-time opportunity with genuine flexibility?
We are working with a highly regarded, established accountancy practice with a long-standing reputation for providing professional, approachable and commercially focused accountancy and taxation services to a diverse portfolio of clients.
Due to continued business requirements, they are looking to welcome a Part-Time Tax / Finance Administrator into their friendly team.

The role will have a particular focus on tax administration, including the preparation and filing of tax returns, requesting and chasing client information, liaising with HMRC and providing general administrative support to the wider team.
A background in finance or accounts would be highly desirable, as would some exposure to payroll or tax administration, although neither is essential. Previous experience contacting or liaising with HMRC would be advantageous. Just as importantly, they are looking for someone with a positive attitude, good organisational skills and a willingness to learn.
What will you be doing?
Your responsibilities will include:
· Providing general administrative and finance support to the accounts and taxation teams.
· Assisting with the administration and filing of personal and business tax returns.
· Sending tax returns and associated documentation to clients, following up and chasing outstanding returns and information to ensure deadlines are met.
· Requesting relevant financial records and supporting documentation from clients to enable the preparation of tax returns.
· Providing payment reminders to clients and following up where necessary.
· Liaising with HMRC regarding tax codes, tax repayments, submissions and general client tax queries.
· Assisting, where required, with responding to HMRC correspondence and following up outstanding matters.
· Assisting with completing tax returns when required, with basic tax knowledge or previous experience being beneficial.
· Supporting the preparation and administration of personal and business tax-related documentation.
· Assisting with payroll administration and associated documentation where required.
· Assisting with replying to and sending emails and letters to clients on behalf of members of the team.
· Handling incoming queries and liaising with clients in a friendly and professional manner.
· Maintaining accurate records, electronic files and financial information.
· Supporting the team with general bookkeeping, data entry and other finance-related administration.
· Providing general office administration and helping to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the practice.
· Helping to ensure deadlines are met and work is completed accurately and efficiently.
What are we looking for?
· Previous experience in an office administration, finance or accounts-related role would be advantageous.
· Some experience of tax administration, including filing tax returns and dealing with client documentation, would be beneficial.
· Previous experience contacting or liaising with HMRC would be preferred, although not essential.
· Basic tax knowledge or previous exposure to personal or business tax returns would be desirable, but full training can be provided.
· Some exposure to payroll would be beneficial, but is not essential.
· Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office.
· Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to communicate professionally with clients and HMRC.
· A proactive, reliable and flexible approach.
· Someone who enjoys working as part of a close-knit team and is happy to get involved.
You don't need to be a qualified accountant or have extensive tax experience. A good grounding in finance, administration or accounts, together with strong organisational and communication skills and the right attitude, are far more important.

This is where the opportunity really stands out!
· Salary: c.£30,000 FTE, pro rata for 21 hours per week.

· Hybrid working: The opportunity to work from home for an agreed proportion of the week.

job.title: Food Technologist
job.description:
Passionate about food, excited by FMCG and ready to make a real impact on quality, safety and innovation?
We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented food technical professional to join a dynamic business bringing the flavours of Italy to the UK.
This is an exciting, varied role combining food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance and product development. Working closely with the Technical Manager and Technical Director, you’ll play a key role in maintaining high standards, supporting innovation and building strong relationships with Italian suppliers and customers.
Fluency in both written and spoken Italian is essential and non-negotiable, as you’ll work directly with Italian suppliers on technical specifications, product development and quality matters.
What will you be doing?
You’ll help ensure our products are safe, compliant and consistently meet customer expectations. Your responsibilities will include:
· Supporting and improving the Quality Management System (QMS), food safety procedures and compliance with relevant legislation and industry standards.
· Managing supplier approval, organic certification requirements and technical documentation.
· Supporting new product development, including product specifications, label approvals, packaging and nutritional information.
· Ensuring allergen declarations and product claims, including gluten-free, vegan and organic, are accurate and compliant.
· Liaising with Italian suppliers and customers on technical requirements, specifications and product quality.
· Managing customer complaints and responding to technical enquiries and questionnaires.
· Coordinating laboratory testing, including shelf-life, microbiological, chemical and allergen testing.
· Supporting internal and external audits, traceability exercises and mass balance checks.
· Delivering food safety and hygiene training and contributing to continuous improvement across the business.
What are we looking for?
We’re looking for someone who combines technical expertise with a genuine passion for food, strong communication skills and a hands-on approach.
You’ll ideally have:
· A degree in Food Science, Food Technology or a related discipline.
· Fluency in written and spoken Italian - essential.
· Experience in a food technical, quality assurance or food safety role within food manufacturing, distribution or FMCG.
· Knowledge of HACCP, food hygiene, food labelling legislation and allergen management.
· Familiarity with BRCGS or other GFSI-recognised certification programmes.
· Experience with technical specifications, supplier approval and quality documentation.
· Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
· A positive, resilient and solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to work collaboratively across the business.
· Relevant food hygiene and HACCP training is expected, with the appropriate qualification level depending on experience.
What can you expect?
No two days will be the same. You’ll work across quality assurance, supplier management, product innovation and compliance, with the opportunity to make a tangible contribution to product quality and business performance.
You’ll work closely with experienced technical leadership in a fast-moving FMCG environment where a passion for great food, continuous improvement and customer satisfaction really matters.
Occasional UK and overseas travel may be required, particularly for supplier visits and audits in Italy.
If you love food, thrive on variety and have the technical expertise and Italian language skills to make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.
